EXP34-C ORACLE COVERAGE, PART B (strict-only keys), hostap: src/radius/radius.c through src/wps/wps_upnp_event.c. These 63 keys are in-scope EXP34-C findings that aurora-lint d21be1b3d reports only at the strict preset (run sqc-0.6.0-d21be1b3d-strict-*; strict sets first_site_only=false and reports every dereference site, not only the first) and that no label covers. Same standard and method as coverage-exp34c-2026-10-calibration and coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-curl-hostap-mbedtls-mosquitto: the dereference is the violation site, judged at strict under EXP34-C/2026-10-07/presets; FP needs proof in the scanned source, a language guarantee, or an ISO C or POSIX library contract (those rows also cite P/facts); open caller sets for exported functions; a strippable assert, a noreturn attribute and an earlier dereference of the same pointer are not proof. A later site inherits an earlier site's FP only when that proof also dominates it with no reassignment between. One read-only research reader drafted each verdict at source in the pinned checkout; the adjudicator reviewed every draft (format and vocabulary, every nearby opposite-verdict label, a source re-read of a sample and of the questioned rows) before inclusion.

RESULT: 37 FP, 26 TP.

FP shapes (medium): radius attribute and header pointers inside the opaque struct radius_msg, whose writers are all enumerated and checked; dominating tests and closed static callers. TP shapes: wpa.c reply set only through the out-parameter of the sm->ctx->alloc_eapol callback, supplied by the open wpa_sm_init (medium); open parameters of os_strcmp/os_strncmp, wpabuf_put and buf_shift_right; an unchecked malloc in trace.c.

22 row(s) name a conflict in provenance with a carried-forward label that predates the 2026-10-07 rulings; existing rows are not edited.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision or recall claim is made here.
